lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 7 distinct vertical segments; one wide primary stripe at the shoulder followed by a sequence of 6 thinner, more narrowly spaced segments towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Posterior line segments are abbreviated and fail to extend to the ventral margin of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots located on the lower haunch, superior to the hock.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature; horns sweep outward and backward from the skull base before curving inward at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Terminal tip span is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white spots visible below the eye; high-contrast tan 'stocking' markings on the lower portions of all four limbs.
